gen-gf-warnes-gf-hepta-slab: Warnes sprawls wide and bold, ink strokes tapering off before they touch. Hepta Slab, a dignified text serif with open counters, would carry pages of reading in a steady, bookish murmur.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-kiwi-maru: Expressive and bold, Warnes tapers its ink strokes to a stop. Kiwi Maru, a traditional text serif with generous letterspace, would keep extended reading unhurried, its terminals stopping well short of the stem.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One reads literary and authoritative, with a wide pitcher-mouth in every c. But Warnes, bold and higher in the lowercase, hands over to that spread-out texture once reading stretches on.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Ink strokes that taper off before they touch give Warnes its bold, expressive look. Stint Ultra Expanded, with its characters floating apart and lower lowercase, gives that loud heading a traditional partner with a pipe-cleaner feel.
gen-gf-yatra-one-fs-rowan: Yatra One is plain and bold, drawn with very low contrast. That makes it good at announcing rather than carrying paragraphs, while Rowan, friendly and middling in contrast, handles the reading.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-amulya: Yomogi is handwritten and friendly, its c opened wide like a crescent wrench. Amulya takes on the sustained, modern work with generous curve gaps, leaving Yomogi's personal touch to be enjoyed lightly.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-neco: A crescent-wrench c and one line width throughout give Yomogi a friendly, hand-drawn personality that is best taken lightly. Neco, a dignified text serif, can take the larger size.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-plein: Plein is a reliable, clean sans with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Plein at a large size would crowd out Yomogi's hand-drawn heading, which asks to be taken lightly.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-recia: Recia is an authoritative, sharp text serif whose light modulation shows mainly up close. Recia keeps its openings generous across weights, so extended reading goes smoothly, while Yomogi's handwriting suits brief bursts.
gen-gf-yomogi-fs-rowan: Friendly and personal, Yomogi keeps a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, good for a line or two. Rowan lets its thick strokes lead the eye gently through longer reading.
